name: Optimized Minimal 3D Gaussian Splatting (OMG)
definition: A method for compact 3D Gaussian representation that retains per-Gaussian parameterization for geometry (scale and rotation) to handle sparsity, while using a small neural field and Sub-Vector Quantization (SVQ) for appearance features to exploit local continuity.
summary: Optimized Minimal 3D Gaussian Splatting is a compact 3D representation that achieves extreme storage compression by combining per-Gaussian geometry with Sub-Vector Quantized appearance features.
